limitations: This exact v21/kernel43 package has not been clean flashed or physically tested. Offline candidate only; no universal compatibility or random black-screen fix claimed.
Independent kernel40 DSI sleep order experiment is excluded; async HWC status cache is not implemented.
Camera APK is a separate optional manual install, not preloaded. Native init property delivery still requires clean-first-boot acceptance.
Real finger double-tap, touch failures, cover behavior, hard black-screen incidents and affected friend-device boots remain unresolved pending physical tests.
OTA notice has an independent valid certificate and zero permissions/components for updating; use only original clean-flash workflow, no forced live install or signature-check bypass.
Only the donor OTA client was removed; generic update_engine/COTA were not globally disabled and independent update paths are not claimed tested.
Double-tap wake, privacy password persistence, OPPO PC transfer/disconnect, communication sharing and real call/rotation audio remain unresolved or awaiting physical tests.
Kernel39 source clean boot was observed on v18, but native vivo wall-charge acceptance and this v19 subsequent reboot remain pending.
Charging fix restores the existing standard 5V fallback path; it does not implement vivo proprietary 90W charging.
v16 first-boot regression reproduced; identical repaired SystemUI clean-flash and reboot passed on HA1W0JA3; last Bilibili seed integration live/offline verified, not clean-flashed again
System gesture injection passes are not proof of all hardware touch, rotation and intermittent input faults being eliminated
Removes one unbounded HWC poll loop; first status read still can wait on kernel lock/SPI; does not repair firmware faults
Deferred refresh request retry and timing callbacks require actual device testing
WLAN margin and HWC changes both included; separate test assets/proofs preserved for fault isolation
Internal test package, not universal-compatibility acceptance
Third DTB corruption is statically repaired; neither affected friend device has tested this package
DTBO, bootloader and other retained firmware are not replaced; target baseline identity still needs confirmation
Speaker0.25 fixes startup and call-release recovery, real four-direction sound and paired call audio remain pending
Communication sharing remains reported nonfunctional; no new communication backend fix in this build
Old optional vendor module delivery/ABI mismatch remains a separate known issue; no forced loading introduced
AI disable control, foreground scheduler and speaker seed default enabled on clean install; existing explicit switches preserved by delivery
Original script clean flash deletes apps, accounts and personal files; failed steps stop without automatic write retry
